items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Henry Brunus? No, I don't.

ctx.x: That's right, he can do anything. He's just a natural.
Oh, that reminds me. He told me once that he got all that stuff mostly from his brother Henry. Do you remember Henry Brunus? No, I don't. Who'd been to the Friars Inn, too.
